suites.canary: The four benchmark sentinels used for the default hotspot workflow.
suites.quick: Small smoke set for local iteration; mirrors the historical comparison filter.
suites.standard: Balanced 24-family set for routine native comparison reports.
suites.cross_family: One representative fixture per admitted diagram family currently registered in this native corpus.
suites.flowchart: Flowchart-focused routing and layout stress coverage.
suites.frontmatter: Frontmatter preprocessing and config ingestion coverage.
suites.stress: Known heavier fixtures used when validating optimization work.
suites.release_control: Explicit classic Dagre configuration controls for native release observations.
suites.full: All fixtures in corpus order; fixture-complete, not family-complete.

suites.closeout: One stable medium fixture for each common ASCII family measured by U25.
suites.comparable: Fixtures whose baseline and head plain-ASCII output identities match.
suites.large-closeout: One tracked representative-large fixture for each of U25's five benchmark families.
